doc.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011

title: Advice to young musicians and goodbyes
summary: His advice is not to leave a wallet in the dressing room. The two thank each other and close the interview.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well anything you want to add to your conversation here today that I didn’t —
How about a word of advice to all young musicians going into the business?
And my only advice is don’t ever leave your wallet in the dressing room when you go on stage. That’s it. It’s the only advice I can give.
That’s a good one. It came from experience huh?
God forbid you lose your musician’s union card too.
Are you still in the union?
Yes I am but, I don’t know. They up and moved. Well thank you.
Thank you very much. I hope it was okay. I had a ball.
Okay. Over and out. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -23-
